units: Integrated mean3x3-pixel brightness: Jy/beam times common local-velocity equivalent km/s; these are not integrated total source fluxes
interpretation: Dirty-to-pre transition includes deconvolution, PSF homogenization and mosaicking differences. Central brightness ratios support localization but do not uniquely isolate an area factor or yield a total-flux correction.
limitations: Dirty and homogenized maps have different effective PSFs
Extended sources, neighbours and dirty PSF shoulders can alter central brightness
No per-pointing model/residual/PSF products or production commit available
